import hashlib,os,pathlib
def snapshot():
    env=os.getenv("QA_COMPLEX","<absent>").encode("utf-8")
    path=pathlib.Path("/etc/secrets/qa-note.txt")
    data=path.read_bytes() if path.exists() else b""
    return {"env_length":len(env),"env_sha256":hashlib.sha256(env).hexdigest(),"file_present":path.exists(),"file_length":len(data),"file_sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}
import json,time
pathlib.Path("qa-built.json").write_text(json.dumps({"marker":'QA163_4acbc9',"snapshot":snapshot(),"build_path":os.getenv("PATH"),"built_at":time.time_ns()}))

import hashlib,os,pathlib
def snapshot():
    env=os.getenv("QA_COMPLEX","<absent>").encode("utf-8")
    path=pathlib.Path("/etc/secrets/qa-note.txt")
    data=path.read_bytes() if path.exists() else b""
    return {"env_length":len(env),"env_sha256":hashlib.sha256(env).hexdigest(),"file_present":path.exists(),"file_length":len(data),"file_sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}
import http.server,json,socket
built=json.loads(pathlib.Path("qa-built.json").read_text())
class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        body=json.dumps({"marker":built["marker"],"built":built,"runtime":snapshot(),"runtime_path":os.getenv("PATH"),"instance":socket.gethostname()}).encode()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type","application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)
    def log_message(self,*args): pass
http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0",int(os.getenv("PORT","3000"))),Handler).serve_forever()
